title: Rava bar She’ilta
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in [Gittin 39b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.39b.14) as finding Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak and asking him a question. Hyman reports the Bach’s reading Rabbah bar Shilat.[^1][^2]

notes.text: In the linked Gemara, Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak finds and questions Rava bar She’ilta at the entrance to a house of prayer. Hyman gives the encounter in the opposite direction.
Hyman attributes the name Rabbah bar Shilat to the Bach.
